final_message:
Done. `src/diff.ts` now implements all three functions:

- **`diffLines`** (`src/diff.ts:15`) — builds a suffix LCS table (one `Uint32Array`, `O(n·m)`), then walks the inputs applying the README's front-built rule: keep equal front lines; otherwise delete from `a` when the suffix LCS length is unchanged (`table[i+1][j] === table[i][j]`), else insert from `b`; leftover tails become `del`/`add` ops.
- **`renderDiff`** (`src/diff.ts:41`) — `"  "`/`"- "`/`"+ "` prefixes joined with `"\n"`, `""` for no ops.
- **`diffStats`** (`src/diff.ts:49`) — counts each op kind.

All 3 tests in `tests/` pass via `npm test`, and the README example (`["x","y"]` vs `["y","z"]` → `[del x, keep y, add z]`) plus empty-input edge cases check out. (No `tsc` available locally, so type checking relied on the test run.)
